★ Request
Display Daring Heart (Tracksuit Summer)
(Fighting against my own limits, looking straight ahead—just charging through!)
See ya tomorrow, Ms. Audience!
..."The Correlation Between Muscle Relaxation and Explosive Top Speed"?

The ones hyping up the crowd were a glamorous cheer squad.
And right in the center stood an Umamusume who completely stole the spotlight—

A talent of this caliber surely already has an exceptional trainer.
There's no place for me here—just as I readjusted my grip on my documents and turned away...

Hey, if something else comes up, will you help me out again?
You seem to have a pretty interesting perspective... What do you say?
See ya tomorrow, Mr. Audience!

It struck my heart like a lightning bolt.
Logic went straight out the window—all I knew was that I wanted to keep chasing that stride.

In exchange, I'll let you watch me put it into practice!
It's a perfect chance to gather live data with your own eyes, isn't it?
Yeah...! I feel totally energized now! Thank you so much, Heart!!
Holding a mountain of paperwork, I hurried along the path back to the Trainer's office.

Trapped by rookie anxieties, I spent all my time on preparations...
and could barely work up the courage to even speak to an Umamusume.
Okay! Of course you can, make sure you keep your eyes glued to me♪
Ride alongside me? On that bicycle?
You're the best! See you at the academy♪

"Anticipating that this will compensate for physical handicaps"... Huh,
did you write this? That's some incredible passion!

For just a split second, I definitely felt it. Once I loosened up, my entire body turned
into a single coiled spring... catapulting me forward with supple ease.

Don't worry. I'll make sure to return it properly!
And what's more, I'll pay you back double... twice over♪

Maybe I haven't completely relaxed my shoulders yet,
since it really was only for an instant.
—She's an Umamusume whose debut is eagerly anticipated by many right now.
Thanks! Then let's go for a run together tomorrow morning♪

She said she wanted to cheer up someone who has a mock race coming up!
Heart is just so passionate and sweet~!
...Hey, would you mind lending this to me?

Let's blow away all those bad vibes!
Everyone together, let's make our heart beat resonate♪

Not at all... It's fascinating.
It means avoiding getting pushed around by physical disadvantages, right?
—Just then, a lively commotion reached my ears.

Her piercing gaze made my heart skip a beat.
If... really. If my analytical data could actually be of use...—
Still, you... you're quite something.

If we polish this theory further, it might actually be viable.
I definitely felt something promising there.
Can I leave the timekeeping to you?

Hehe... I thought a passionate love letter came flying my way.
—...Huh?
...Are you okay?

Hey, everyone! Are you ready to hype it up?
Looking down is a waste! Chin up and look at me!

No matter how hard I pedaled, her back kept pulling further away.
As if we belonged to entirely different worlds...—

(—I'll turn this theory into wings.
And... I'll surpass who I am today...!)

Thanks for playing along with my sudden whim, everyone!
—...So? Did that get you fired up too?

Sudden cheerleading during lunchtime?!
Leave it to Heart, though—look at how huge of a crowd showed up~!!

Once she took off, she didn't look back even once.
Tearing through the wind, she accelerated sharply and powerfully.

Known by everyone in the racing world...
A promising prospect hailing from the prestigious "Hilesta Academy" development club.
(Whooooooosh...!!)

Good morning! I've got all the data memorized.
Now then, let's see what happens with your theory, shall we?

"While minimizing air resistance and eliminating wasted motion,
unleash explosive energy at the moment of impact. Through this—"

Nice work! Hehe, you're really out of breath, aren't you?
Sorry about that... I got carried away and lost myself in the run.
